name: Dimensional Out-of-Tolerance
description: Measured feature falls outside the drawing tolerance band.

name: Surface Defect
description: Scoring, pitting or tool marks on a finished face.

name: Burr
description: Residual material left at an edge after machining.

name: Crack
description: Visible or detected crack; the part is scrapped.

name: Thread Damage
description: Stripped, crossed or incomplete thread form.

name: Material Defect
description: Inclusion, porosity or incorrect material grade.

name: Incorrect Assembly
description: Component assembled out of sequence or with the wrong part.

name: Heat Treatment Failure
description: Hardness or case depth outside specification after treatment.
